questions.q: Which structure is found in plant cells but NOT in animal cells?
questions.qAf: Watter struktuur word in plantselle gevind, maar NIE in dierselle nie?
questions.explain: Plant cells have three extra structures: a cell wall, chloroplasts and a large vacuole. Both cell types have a membrane, nucleus and mitochondria.
questions.explainAf: Plantselle het drie ekstra strukture: 'n selwand, chloroplaste en 'n groot vakuool. Albei seltipes het 'n membraan, kern en mitochondria.

questions.q: Where in the lungs does gas exchange take place?
questions.qAf: Waar in die longe vind gaswisseling plaas?
questions.explain: Oxygen diffuses from the alveoli into the blood in the capillaries, and carbon dioxide diffuses the other way. Millions of alveoli give a huge surface area.
questions.explainAf: Suurstof diffundeer uit die alveoli in die bloed in die haarvate, en koolstofdioksied diffundeer andersom. Miljoene alveoli gee 'n enorme oppervlakarea.

questions.q: Which part of a flower produces pollen?
questions.qAf: Watter deel van 'n blom produseer stuifmeel?
questions.explain: The anther, on its filament, makes up the stamen (the male part). The stigma receives pollen and the ovary holds the ovules.
questions.explainAf: Die helmknop, op sy helmdraad, vorm die meeldraad (die manlike deel). Die stempel ontvang stuifmeel en die vrugbeginsel bevat die saadknoppe.

questions.q: A learner adds iodine solution to a food sample and it turns blue-black. What does the food contain?
questions.qAf: 'n Leerder voeg jodiumoplossing by 'n voedselmonster en dit word blou-swart. Wat bevat die voedsel?
questions.explain: Iodine turns blue-black with starch. Biuret reagent tests for protein, and fat leaves a see-through greasy mark on brown paper.
questions.explainAf: Jodium word blou-swart met stysel. Biuretreagens toets vir proteïen, en vet laat 'n deurskynende vetkol op bruin papier.

questions.q: Sodium has an atomic number of 11 and a mass number of 23. How many neutrons does a sodium atom have?
questions.qAf: Natrium het 'n atoomgetal van 11 en 'n massagetal van 23. Hoeveel neutrone het 'n natriumatoom?
questions.explain: N = A − Z = 23 − 11 = 12 neutrons.
questions.explainAf: N = A − Z = 23 − 11 = 12 neutrone.

questions.q: An element is in Period 3 and Group 7. What is its electron arrangement?
questions.qAf: 'n Element is in Periode 3 en Groep 7. Wat is sy elektronrangskikking?
questions.explain: Period 3 means 3 shells and Group 7 means 7 valence electrons: 2,8,7. That is chlorine.
questions.explainAf: Periode 3 beteken 3 doppe en Groep 7 beteken 7 valenselektrone: 2,8,7. Dit is chloor.

questions.q: A solution has a pH of 3. How would you describe it?
questions.qAf: 'n Oplossing het 'n pH van 3. Hoe sou jy dit beskryf?
options: It cannot be described from its pH
optionsAf: Dit kan nie uit sy pH beskryf word nie
questions.explain: pH 0–6 is acidic, 7 is neutral and 8–14 is alkaline. Vinegar and lemon juice are around pH 2–3.
questions.explainAf: pH 0–6 is suur, 7 is neutraal en 8–14 is alkalies. Asyn en suurlemoensap is ongeveer pH 2–3.

questions.q: What are the products when an acid neutralises a base?
questions.qAf: Wat is die produkte wanneer 'n suur 'n basis neutraliseer?
questions.explain: Acid + base → salt + water. For example, HCl + NaOH → NaCl + H₂O.
questions.explainAf: Suur + basis → sout + water. Byvoorbeeld HCl + NaOH → NaCl + H₂O.

questions.q: Which of these is a longitudinal wave?
questions.qAf: Watter een hiervan is 'n longitudinale golf?
questions.explain: In sound, particles vibrate parallel to the direction of travel, making compressions and rarefactions. Light, radio waves and X-rays are transverse EM waves.
questions.explainAf: By klank vibreer deeltjies parallel aan die bewegingsrigting, wat kompressies en verdunnings vorm. Lig, radiogolwe en X-strale is transversale EM-golwe.

questions.q: A wave has a frequency of 50 Hz and a wavelength of 2 m. What is its speed? (v = f × λ)
questions.qAf: 'n Golf het 'n frekwensie van 50 Hz en 'n golflengte van 2 m. Wat is sy spoed? (v = f × λ)

questions.q: A magnet is moved into a coil of wire connected to a meter. Which change will induce a BIGGER current?
questions.qAf: 'n Magneet word in 'n draadspoel ingeskuif wat aan 'n meter gekoppel is. Watter verandering sal 'n GROTER stroom induseer?
options: Holding the magnet still inside the coil
optionsAf: Om die magneet vinniger te beweeg
Om minder draaie draad te gebruik
Om die magneet stil binne die spoel te hou
questions.explain: A faster change in magnetic flux induces a bigger current. A stronger magnet, more turns or a soft iron core also help; a magnet that does not move induces nothing.
questions.explainAf: 'n Vinniger verandering in magnetiese vloed induseer 'n groter stroom. 'n Sterker magneet, meer draaie of 'n sagte ysterkern help ook; 'n magneet wat nie beweeg nie, induseer niks.

questions.q: What does a fuse do in a circuit?
questions.qAf: Wat doen 'n sekering in 'n stroombaan?
options: It melts and breaks the circuit if the current becomes too large
It stores extra electricity for later
It makes the current flow faster
optionsAf: Dit smelt en breek die stroombaan as die stroom te groot word
Dit stoor ekstra elektrisiteit vir later
Dit laat die stroom vinniger vloei
questions.explain: A fuse is a thin wire that melts when the current is too large, preventing overheating and fires. A circuit breaker does the same job but can be reset.
questions.explainAf: 'n Sekering is 'n dun draad wat smelt wanneer die stroom te groot is, wat oorverhitting en brande voorkom. 'n Stroombreker doen dieselfde werk, maar kan herstel word.

questions.q: When is load shedding used?
questions.qAf: Wanneer word beurtkrag gebruik?
options: When the demand for electricity is greater than the supply available
When power stations make too much electricity
When it is sunny and windy
optionsAf: Wanneer die vraag na elektrisiteit groter is as die beskikbare aanbod
Wanneer kragstasies te veel elektrisiteit opwek
Elke nag, om steenkool te spaar
Wanneer dit sonnig en winderig is
questions.explain: Load shedding is a planned, controlled switch-off of areas when demand exceeds supply. It protects the whole grid from an uncontrolled collapse.
questions.explainAf: Beurtkrag is 'n beplande, beheerde afskakeling van gebiede wanneer die vraag die aanbod oorskry. Dit beskerm die hele netwerk teen 'n onbeheerde ineenstorting.

questions.q: In which layer of the atmosphere is the ozone layer found?
questions.qAf: In watter laag van die atmosfeer word die osoonlaag gevind?
questions.explain: The ozone layer is in the stratosphere, about 20–35 km up. It absorbs most of the Sun's harmful UV radiation.
questions.explainAf: Die osoonlaag is in die stratosfeer, ongeveer 20–35 km hoog. Dit absorbeer die meeste van die Son se skadelike UV-straling.

questions.q: Marble forms when limestone is changed by intense heat and pressure without melting. What type of rock is marble?
questions.qAf: Marmer vorm wanneer kalksteen deur hoë hitte en druk verander word sonder om te smelt. Watter soort gesteente is marmer?
questions.explain: Heat and pressure change existing rock into metamorphic rock. Igneous rock forms from cooling magma or lava; sedimentary rock from compacted sediment.
questions.explainAf: Hitte en druk verander bestaande gesteente in metamorfe gesteente. Stollingsgesteente vorm uit afkoelende magma of lawa; sedimentêre gesteente uit saamgeperste sediment.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: In humans, fertilisation usually takes place in the fallopian tube.
questions.qAf: By mense vind bevrugting gewoonlik in die Fallopiusbuis plaas.
questions.explain: True. The sperm travel through the cervix and uterus into the fallopian tubes, where fertilisation usually happens.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Die sperms beweeg deur die serviks en uterus tot in die Fallopiusbuise, waar bevrugting gewoonlik plaasvind.

questions.q: Isotopes of an element have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
questions.qAf: Isotope van 'n element het dieselfde aantal protone, maar verskillende getalle neutrone.
questions.explain: True. Carbon-12 and carbon-14 are both carbon (6 protons), but carbon-14 has 2 extra neutrons.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Koolstof-12 en koolstof-14 is albei koolstof (6 protone), maar koolstof-14 het 2 ekstra neutrone.

questions.q: An acid turns blue litmus paper red.
questions.qAf: 'n Suur laat blou lakmoespapier rooi word.
questions.explain: True. Acids turn blue litmus red, and bases turn red litmus blue.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Sure laat blou lakmoes rooi word, en basisse laat rooi lakmoes blou word.

questions.q: Two north poles of magnets pushed together will repel each other.
questions.qAf: Twee noordpole van magnete wat na mekaar gedruk word, sal mekaar afstoot.
questions.explain: True. Like poles repel and unlike poles attract.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Gelyke pole stoot mekaar af en ongelyke pole trek mekaar aan.

questions.q: In a series circuit, if one bulb breaks, the other bulbs keep working.
questions.qAf: In 'n seriestroombaan, as een gloeilamp breek, werk die ander gloeilampe aan.
questions.explain: False. A series circuit has only one path, so a break stops everything. In a parallel circuit the other branches keep working.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. 'n Seriestroombaan het net een pad, dus stop 'n breuk alles. In 'n parallelle stroombaan werk die ander takke aan.

questions.q: The natural greenhouse effect is harmful and Earth would be better off without it.
questions.qAf: Die natuurlike kweekhuiseffek is skadelik en die Aarde sou beter af wees daarsonder.
questions.explain: False. Without it, Earth's average temperature would be about −18 °C instead of +15 °C. The problem is the enhanced greenhouse effect caused by extra human-produced gases.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Daarsonder sou die Aarde se gemiddelde temperatuur ongeveer −18 °C wees in plaas van +15 °C. Die probleem is die versterkte kweekhuiseffek wat deur ekstra gasse van mense veroorsaak word.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each part of a cell in column A with its function in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke deel van 'n sel in kolom A by sy funksie in kolom B.
pairs: Release energy from food through cellular respiration
Controls what enters and leaves the cell
pairsAf: Stel energie uit voedsel vry deur sellulêre respirasie
Beheer wat die sel binnegaan en verlaat
questions.explain: The nucleus controls the cell, mitochondria are the powerhouse, the membrane controls what passes in and out, and chloroplasts contain chlorophyll for photosynthesis.
questions.explainAf: Die kern beheer die sel, mitochondria is die kragstasie, die membraan beheer wat in en uit beweeg, en chloroplaste bevat chlorofil vir fotosintese.

questions.q: Match each type of chemical bond in column A with how it forms in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke soort chemiese binding in kolom A by hoe dit vorm in kolom B.
pairs: Electrons are transferred from a metal to a non-metal
Pairs of electrons are shared between non-metals
Metal ions sit in a sea of delocalised electrons
pairsAf: Elektrone word van 'n metaal na 'n nie-metaal oorgedra
Metaalione is in 'n see van gedelokaliseerde elektrone
extra: Protons are shared between two nuclei
extraAf: Protone word tussen twee kerne gedeel
questions.explain: Ionic: transfer (metal + non-metal). Covalent: sharing (non-metal + non-metal). Metallic: a sea of delocalised electrons. Protons never move between atoms.
questions.explainAf: Ionies: oordrag (metaal + nie-metaal). Kovalent: deling (nie-metaal + nie-metaal). Metaalbinding: 'n see van gedelokaliseerde elektrone. Protone beweeg nooit tussen atome nie.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each equation to the type of reaction it shows.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke vergelyking aan die soort reaksie wat dit wys.
questions.explain: Synthesis makes one product; decomposition starts from one reactant; in single displacement a more reactive element pushes out another; in double displacement two compounds swap ions.
questions.explainAf: Sintese maak een produk; ontbinding begin met een reaktant; by enkelverplasing stoot 'n meer reaktiewe element 'n ander uit; by dubbelverplasing ruil twee verbindings ione om.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each of Earth's spheres to an example of it.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elk van die Aarde se sfere aan 'n voorbeeld daarvan.
questions.explain: Air is the atmosphere, water the hydrosphere, rock the lithosphere and life the biosphere. The four spheres constantly interact.
questions.explainAf: Lug is die atmosfeer, water die hidrosfeer, rots die litosfeer en lewe die biosfeer. Die vier sfere wissel voortdurend op mekaar in.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put these parts of the electromagnetic spectrum in order from LOWEST to HIGHEST frequency.
questions.qAf: Plaas hierdie dele van die elektromagnetiese spektrum in volgorde van LAAGSTE tot HOOGSTE frekwensie.
questions.explain: Radio waves have the lowest frequency (longest wavelength); gamma rays the highest frequency and the most energy, which makes them the most dangerous.
questions.explainAf: Radiogolwe het die laagste frekwensie (langste golflengte); gammastrale die hoogste frekwensie en die meeste energie, wat hulle die gevaarlikste maak.

questions.q: Put the stages in the life of a star like our Sun in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die fases in die lewe van 'n ster soos ons Son in die korrekte volgorde.
questions.explain: A lower-mass star: nebula → main sequence → red giant → planetary nebula → white dwarf. A massive star ends as a supernova instead.
questions.explainAf: 'n Laer-massa ster: newel → hoofreeks → rooi reus → planetêre newel → witdwerg. 'n Massiewe ster eindig eerder as 'n supernova.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: In humans, the allele for brown eyes (B) is dominant over the allele for blue eyes (b). Two parents both have the genotype Bb.
questions.scenarioAf: By mense is die alleel vir bruin oë (B) dominant oor die alleel vir blou oë (b). Twee ouers het albei die genotipe Bb.

questions.q: What is the chance that one of their children will have blue eyes?
questions.qAf: Wat is die kans dat een van hul kinders blou oë sal hê?
questions.explain: Bb × Bb gives 1 BB : 2 Bb : 1 bb. Only bb has blue eyes, so the chance is 1 in 4, or 25%.
questions.explainAf: Bb × Bb gee 1 BB : 2 Bb : 1 bb. Net bb het blou oë, dus is die kans 1 uit 4, of 25%.

questions.q: How do we describe the parents' genotype, Bb?
questions.qAf: Hoe beskryf ons die ouers se genotipe, Bb?
questions.explain: Bb has one of each allele, so it is heterozygous. BB is homozygous dominant and bb homozygous recessive.
questions.explainAf: Bb het een van elke alleel, dus is dit heterosigoties. BB is homosigoties dominant en bb homosigoties resessief.

questions.q: A child of these parents who has brown eyes could have the genotype BB or Bb.
questions.qAf: 'n Kind van hierdie ouers wat bruin oë het, kan die genotipe BB of Bb hê.
questions.explain: True. B masks b, so BB and Bb both give brown eyes. You cannot tell the genotype just by looking at the phenotype.
questions.explainAf: Waar. B oorheers b, dus gee BB en Bb albei bruin oë. Jy kan nie die genotipe net deur na die fenotipe te kyk, bepaal nie.

questions.scenario: Two learners push the same box. One pushes to the right with 40 N. The other pushes to the left with 25 N.
questions.scenarioAf: Twee leerders stoot dieselfde boks. Een stoot na regs met 40 N. Die ander stoot na links met 25 N.

questions.q: What is the resultant force on the box?
questions.qAf: Wat is die resulterende krag op die boks?
questions.explain: Opposite forces are subtracted: 40 − 25 = 15 N, in the direction of the bigger force (right).
questions.explainAf: Teenoorgestelde kragte word afgetrek: 40 − 25 = 15 N, in die rigting van die groter krag (regs).

questions.q: The forces on the box are balanced, so the box does not change its motion.
questions.qAf: Die kragte op die boks is gebalanseerd, dus verander die boks nie sy beweging nie.
questions.explain: False. The resultant force is not zero, so the forces are unbalanced and the box accelerates to the right.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Die resulterende krag is nie nul nie, dus is die kragte ongebalanseerd en die boks versnel na regs.
